summary: Completed OFFLINE artifact validation only for activation_certificate.schema.json and crossing_decision_table.v1.json using Draft202012Validator.check_schema and Draft202012Validator+FormatChecker. Built a clearly labeled SYNTHETIC REVIEW FIXTURE and 24 saved counterexample/control payloads; several semantically inconsistent claims are still schema-valid.

critical.issue: No cross-field constraints enforce LIVE-VERIFIED consistency (e.g., blocked=true with LIVE-VERIFIED, nonempty mocked_components, triggers_fired while blocked=false all schema-valid).
No chronology/consistency constraints enforce temporal ordering or arithmetic invariants (run end before start, negative reconciliation counters, mismatch sums all schema-valid).
Policy artifact has declarative rows only; action/condition resolution semantics are absent in artifacts and cannot be execution-verified from static JSON alone.

minor.issue: not_measured with measured_value=null is not representable due to measured_value type excluding null.

action_items: Treat current pass/fail as schema-shape evidence only; do not treat as runtime-policy enforcement evidence.
If activation blockers require semantic guarantees, add separate verifier/resolver layer (outside this task) for cross-field state, chronology, arithmetic, and authority-trigger coupling.
Preserve row4 controlled/frontier pilot disablement unless a distinct receipted class-specific change plus per-call authority is introduced.
Keep unassessed->controlled conservative routing behavior explicit in resolver logic; do not erase not-assessed eligibility paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Original schema and policy hashes match provided authoritative values exactly.
Raw policy contains 5 rows and default_when_no_row_matches=REFUSE; no embellished top-level or row-level metadata (row_id/priority/conditions/scope) present.
Row4 (controlled/frontier) and uncontrolled/frontier row both require external_crossing=masked_permitted; ceremony is natural-language string only.
Counterexamples demonstrate many semantically inconsistent states remain schema-valid; this is expected from static schema scope and is not proof of bypass execution.
seed_data_creation: Created SYNTHETIC/MOCKED review fixture and saved synthetic counterexample payloads only; no runtime/app/database state touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use results_matrix.json as machine-readable truth table of accepted/rejected cases and exact failure paths. All tests are offline static artifact checks only; no resolver execution exists in artifacts.
rca of the issue: Repro: pytest /app/assessment_workspace/notes/live_activation_v1_3_artifact_review/validation/test_artifact_validation_offline.py -v --tb=short --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_artifact_validation_iteration36.xml. Root cause: schema/policy artifacts encode structural declarations but limited cross-field semantics; therefore multiple semantically inconsistent payloads remain valid JSON instances under current schema.
